_note: The one supported P4 profile of the ctl_timing_01 candidate (review af7bd434, section 6). Each value is stated once here and cross-checked against its source by tests/test_supported_profile.py. Arbitrary input sizes are not supported.

encoding.read_ranges_note: (qualifier, start, stop) of the G10V2 re-encoding (read_reencode_01/profile_check.py READ_RANGES)
encoding.control_partition_note: the 22 native SELECT/OPERATE application octets split 15/6/1 into transport frames 28/19/14

clock.rounding: durations in ns are converted to T units by t_config.t_units (one shared writer)

timing_ns.note: qualification values of the ctl_m10_* configs; the held-OPERATE block uses held_operate_overrides

ports.note: the ctl_m10_* configs' ports_map: both software endpoints on device port 9 (VEPA hairpin); no physical relay in this profile
